This is a list of volumes of the {{OBP|Pocket Monsters BW|Kosaku Anakubo}} manga created by 穴久保幸作 [[Kosaku Anakubo]]. There are four volumes in total currently released in Japan by [[Shogakukan]]. The Pocket Monsters BW manga has not been officially translated into English.
